s: About what share of India's trade by value is carried by sea?
x: Sea routes carry about 95% of India's trade by volume but only about 70% by value (Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways / PIB).

s: How many non-major ports does India have?
x: India has 12 major and 217 non-major ports; sea routes carry ~95% of its trade by volume and ~70% by value.

s: In which year was the agreement establishing the New Development Bank signed?
x: The NDB agreement was signed at the 6th BRICS Summit, Fortaleza, in July 2014; the bank opened in Shanghai and began operations in 2015.

s: In which year was the New Development Bank agreement signed, and where is the bank headquartered?
x: The NDB agreement was signed at Fortaleza in 2014 (operations from 2015); the bank is headquartered in Shanghai and led by President Dilma Rousseff.

s: When was the India–AI Impact Summit held in New Delhi?
x: The India–AI Impact Summit ran 16–20 February 2026 at Bharat Mandapam (leaders' segment 19–20 Feb; Expo extended to 21 Feb, when the New Delhi Declaration was adopted).

s: To what level were India–Italy ties elevated in 2026?
x: During PM Modi's visit to Italy (19–20 May 2026), India and Italy elevated ties to a Special Strategic Partnership (up from the 2023 Strategic Partnership).

s: In April 2026 the IMF projected India's FY27 growth at about what?
x: The IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook raised India's FY27 (2026-27) growth projection to 6.5%, from 6.4% in January; 6.2% was the October 2025 figure.

s: In January 2026 the IMF raised India's 2025-26 growth projection to what?
x: The IMF's January 2026 WEO Update raised India's 2025-26 growth to 7.3%; its April 2026 WEO put FY27 at 6.5%.

s: In which year did India leave the FGFA programme?
x: India joined the Indo-Russian FGFA (Su-57-based) programme in 2007 and pulled out in 2018 (reported 20 April 2018).

s: Who is the CEO of NITI Aayog?
x: Anurag Jain (1989-batch IAS) took charge as NITI Aayog CEO on 17 August 2026; Nidhi Chhibber had held additional charge after B.V.R. Subrahmanyam's term ended in February 2026.

s: Who is the Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri was appointed NITI Aayog Vice-Chairperson in April 2026 (took charge May 2026), succeeding Suman Bery.

s: Who is the Vice-Chairman of NITI Aayog?
x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri became NITI Aayog Vice-Chairman in April 2026, succeeding Suman Bery (2022-26).

s: In which year was NITI Aayog set up?
x: NITI Aayog was set up on 1 January 2015 (HQ New Delhi); its Vice-Chairman is now Ashok Kumar Lahiri (from April 2026).

s: The 18th BRICS Summit theme expands which acronym?
x: The theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' spells BRICS; the 18th Summit was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, 12–13 September 2026.

s: Where is the headquarters of the New Development Bank located?
x: The New Development Bank is headquartered in Shanghai, China; its agreement was signed in 2014 (Fortaleza) and it began operations in 2015.

s: Which NITI Aayog Vice Chairman described QCOs as a 'malign intervention'?
x: Suman Bery (then NITI Aayog Vice Chairman) called QCOs a "malign intervention".

s: Telangana's Rachakonda police commissionerate was renamed what (2026)?
x: Rachakonda was renamed Malkajgiri (not the reverse); Future City is the new fourth commissionerate.

s: Where is EAGLE of Andhra Pradesh headquartered?
x: EAGLE (Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement) has its headquarters at Mangalagiri (Guntur district), where the anti-drug website was launched in June 2026 and the Red Cross MoU was signed in August 2026.

s: What FDI inflow did UNCTAD's World Investment Report 2026 report for India in 2025?
x: WIR 2026 (7 July 2026): India's FDI inflows rose 44% to USD 38.89 bn in 2025 (USD 27.09 bn in 2024), lifting India to 11th; the January 2026 preliminary estimate had been about USD 47 bn.

s: According to UNCTAD's World Investment Report 2026, India's FDI inflows in 2025 rose by 44% to approximately:
x: WIR 2026: India's FDI inflows rose 44% to about $38.89 billion in 2025, making India the 11th-largest recipient.

s: The World Investment Report 2026, which put India's 2025 FDI inflows at USD 38.89 billion, is published by:
x: The World Investment Report is UNCTAD's; its 2026 edition put India's 2025 FDI at USD 38.89 bn (+44%), 11th in the world.

s: In 2025, India's FDI inflows rose 44% to USD 38.89 bn, according to which body's World Investment Report 2026?
x: UNCTAD's World Investment Report 2026 put India's 2025 FDI inflows at USD 38.89 bn, up 44%, ranking India 11th.

s: Which country became the 11th to accept UPI, in September 2026?
x: Uzbekistan became the 11th country to accept UPI (UPI–UZQR via NIPL and Uzbekistan's NIPC, 31 Aug / 1 Sep 2026). Greece was the 10th; the Maldives' Favara–UPI link (30 July 2026) is a remittance corridor into India, not UPI acceptance.

s: By August 2026, before Uzbekistan joined, UPI was accepted in how many countries?
x: UPI was accepted in 10 countries (Singapore, UAE, France, Mauritius, Nepal, Bhutan, Qatar, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Greece); Uzbekistan became the 11th on 1 September 2026. The Maldives' Favara link (30 July 2026) is a remittance corridor, not counted.

s: Which country's instant payment system Favara was linked with India's UPI on 30 July 2026?
x: The Maldives Monetary Authority's Favara–UPI cross-border corridor went live on 30 July 2026 for person-to-person remittances to India.

s: What was India's record gross GST revenue in April 2026?
x: April 2026 gross GST was a record ₹2,42,702 crore (≈₹2.43 lakh crore), +8.7% over ₹2.23 lakh crore in April 2025; net ₹2.11 lakh crore.

s: When was NRLM renamed DAY-NRLM?
x: NRLM (Aajeevika), launched by the Ministry of Rural Development in June 2011 by restructuring SGSY, was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–NRLM in November 2015.

s: NRLM was launched in June 2011 by restructuring which scheme?
x: NRLM (Aajeevika) restructured SGSY and was launched in June 2011; it was renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: DAY-NRLM was originally launched as NRLM in which year?
x: NRLM was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development in June 2011 (SGSY's restructuring was approved in 2010); it was renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: In which year was NRLM renamed DAY-NRLM?
x: NRLM was launched in June 2011 by restructuring SGSY and renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: From which scheme was NRLM restructured in 2011?
x: NRLM was restructured from SGSY and launched in June 2011; it was renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

Ministry of Women and Child Development

x: SGSY was restructured as NRLM, branded Aajeevika (approved 2010, launched June 2011); it was renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: The next phase of the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) has been re-appraised for which period?
x: The next phase of DAY-NRLM has been re-appraised for the 2026–27 to 2030–31 cycle. NRLM was launched in June 2011 and renamed DAY-NRLM in November 2015.

s: NPCI's UPI Merchant Discount Rate framework was originally due to take effect from which date before being deferred?
x: The MDR (0.4% on eligible P2M payments above ₹2,000) was due from 15 October 2026; on 13 October 2026 NPCI deferred it until after Diwali, with the new date to be notified.

s: UPI MDR was originally to apply from which date (later deferred till after Diwali)?
x: NPCI's MDR framework was due from 15 October 2026 but was deferred on 13 October 2026 until after Diwali; no new date had been notified.

s: Under NPCI's UPI MDR framework (notified September 2026), UPI stays free for whom?
x: Under NPCI's MDR framework, UPI stays free for consumers; the merchant fee, due from 15 Oct 2026, was deferred till after Diwali.

s: In October 2026, what RBI policy move was considered likely?
x: A rate hike was considered likely in October 2026 (the same month NPCI deferred the UPI MDR, due 15 Oct 2026, till after Diwali).

s: Mayank Chakraborty became India's which Grandmaster?
x: Mayank Chakraborty: India's 94th Grandmaster — first from the Northeast (Guwahati); final norm in Sweden. FIDE (est. 1924, Lausanne) has been headed by Timur Turlov since September 2026.

s: Who took charge as Interim President of FIDE on July 24, 2026?
x: Viswanathan Anand became Interim FIDE President in July 2026 after Arkady Dvorkovich stepped aside; at the Samarkand General Assembly (26–27 Sep 2026) Timur Turlov was elected President and Anand Deputy President.

s: The absence of a Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2025 was notable because it was:
x: No Khel Ratna was given for 2025 — the third such year after 2008 and 2014, and the first since 2014.

s: The National Tiger Conservation Authority was established in?
x: NTCA was constituted in 2006 under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 as amended in 2006; Project Tiger dates from 1973 and the Central Zoo Authority from 1992.

s: In which year was the NTCA established?
x: NTCA was constituted in 2006 under Section 38L of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 (2006 amendment).

s: According to the Sustainable Development Report 2026, what was India's rank in 2015, when the SDGs were adopted?
x: SDR 2026 puts India at 112th in 2015 and 94th in 2026 — a rise of 18 places (India was also 112th in the SDR 2023 edition).

s: Per SRS 2024, which State/UT had the lowest Total Fertility Rate (1.2)?
x: SRS 2024: Delhi had the lowest TFR (1.2); Kerala, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal 1.3; Bihar highest (2.9).

s: Ramayapatnam port is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Ramayapatnam (Gudluru mandal) is in Prakasam district: the Kandukur division, in SPSR Nellore from 2022, returned to Prakasam on 31 Dec 2025. Mulapeta (Bhavanapadu) is in Srikakulam.

s: Mulapeta (Bhavanapadu) port is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Mulapeta (Bhavanapadu) is in Srikakulam; Ramayapatnam is in Prakasam.

s: Ramayapatnam port, placed in SPSR Nellore by the Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, lies in which district after the December 2025 district reorganisation?
x: Ramayapatnam is in Gudluru mandal of the Kandukur division, which moved to SPSR Nellore in 2022 and returned to Prakasam on 31 Dec 2025 — matching the APPSC 2024 key (Prakasam). Krishna has Machilipatnam port, Srikakulam has Mulapeta, Kakinada the Kakinada ports.

s: Which AP port is a deep-water port serving the southern hinterland?
x: Ramayapatnam (Prakasam district, Gudluru mandal) is the deep-water greenfield port serving the southern hinterland.

s: Ramayapatnam port is in which district of Andhra Pradesh (after the December 2025 reorganisation)?
x: Ramayapatnam is in Prakasam: the Kandukur division (Gudluru mandal) returned from SPSR Nellore to Prakasam on 31 Dec 2025. Kakinada SEZ Port is in Kakinada.

s: BPCL's refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in AP is at which place?
x: BPCL's refinery-cum-petrochemical complex is near Ramayapatnam port (Prakasam district); Nakkapalli (Anakapalli) is the ArcelorMittal Nippon steel site.

s: How many lane-km of Bituminous Concrete were laid in 24 hours on NH-544G for the January 2026 Guinness record?
x: NHAI and Rajpath Infracon laid 28.89 lane-km (a 3-lane, 9.63 km stretch) and 10,655 t of bituminous concrete in 24 hours near Puttaparthi on 6 January 2026 (some reports say 28.95 km).

s: On which highway did Rajpath Infracon set a Guinness record of 28.89 lane-km of bituminous concrete in 24 hours?
x: The record (6 Jan 2026) was on NH-544G, the Bengaluru–Kadapa–Vijayawada Economic Corridor, in Sri Sathya Sai district.

s: AI4AP Police was piloted in which districts?
x: The AI4AP Police pilot was implemented in Chittoor, Guntur and Annamayya districts in February 2026.
